title: Ivo
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Eruvin 36b: Rav said, “Our Mishnah is not [authoritative], since Ivo taught [otherwise].” Hyman reports that Rashi there explains that Ivo was a sage.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Eruvin 36b paragraph has Rav rejecting the Mishnah on the basis of what Ivo recited. Hyman’s Rashi gloss identifying Ivo as a sage remains his report, without a fresh Rashi collation or an identification with another Ivo.
